rules.description: Lines follow the connection table (basic events are leaves).
A fault tree has one top event.
A gate has at least two inputs.
An inhibit gate has one input and one condition.
k is between 1 and the number of inputs.
A fault tree has no cycles.
Each transfer in has its transfer out.
A path runs from start to end.
Every block is on a path from the start.
Every block gives its availability data.
A branch point has a success and a failure branch.
Every path ends in an outcome.
Ratings are whole numbers from 1 to 10.
The RPN is severity times occurrence times detection.
Every failure mode names its end effect.
